title: Streamify
subtitle: Video Sharing REST API
description: A modular layered REST API engineered with JWT Bearer authentication, ownership-based authorization, Cloudinary media storage, and MongoDB query optimization using compound indexes and atomic operations.
highlights: Layered REST API with JWT Bearer authentication and ownership-based authorization
Cloudinary integration for video and thumbnail asset pipelines
Indexed MongoDB query optimization with explain() scans and atomic $addToSet / $pull operations

title: MTECH-BOT
subtitle: AI Study Assistant
description: An AI-powered academic study assistant designed around M.Tech coursework featuring interactive quiz generation, smart flashcard views, document topic extraction, and contextual study material chat.
highlights: Contextual AI chat assistant tailored for M.Tech advanced coursework
Dynamic interactive quiz creation and real-time flashcard view generator
Automated document topic extraction and curriculum concept synthesis

title: REALTIM-map
subtitle: Real-Time Geolocation Tracker
description: A real-time device location tracking web application using WebSockets to broadcast live geographic coordinates and render dynamic location markers on interactive Leaflet maps.
highlights: Browser Geolocation API emission and multi-client coordinate tracking
Live marker updates and dynamic disconnect cleanups on Leaflet maps

title: Hotel Backend
subtitle: Hotel Staff Management System
description: A backend database solution to automate hotel staff record handling using structured Mongoose schemas, role-based access control (RBAC), and currency conversion API integration.
highlights: Comprehensive CRUD and bulk operations for 6+ distinct staff roles
JWT authentication and RBAC middleware to protect administrative routes
Currency conversion third-party API integration for financial operations

title: Reconfigurable 6G Communication System
subtitle: Absorber/Reflector Metasurface
description: Final-year ECE group project based on a reconfigurable absorber/reflector concept for 6G communication systems. Developed switchable metasurface structures evaluated via electromagnetic simulation.
highlights: Dynamically switchable absorber and reflector metasurface structures
Electromagnetic absorption and reflection analysis across targeted sub-THz frequencies
Hardware and RF simulation-grounded research project
